metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skills and plugins.

plugins.name: spec-generator
plugins.description: Interview the user about a project, then produce a production-ready SPEC.md (plus CLAUDE.md and an optional private spec).

plugins.name: fusion-harness
plugins.description: Fuse Claude with the Codex CLI: Watchdog auto-reviews each turn, Duel Plan co-plans with debate, Duel Review reviews a PR with two agents, Consult fetches a second opinion.

plugins.name: signs-of-ai-writing
plugins.description: Check writing for the tells of AI-generated text, surface and structural, and report each with the quoted span, category, and fix, or return a de-slopped rewrite.

plugins.name: reprompt
plugins.description: Rewrites a prompt to be more ambitious through Altitude (the outcome behind the task), Depth (raw material, a professional's instruments, an outside judge) and Range (methods from other fields), after Felix Rieseberg's post, and returns one rewritten prompt. Runs only as /reprompt.
